experiment: Development-only 1:1 mortality undersampling with prior and Platt calibration comparisons
preprocessing: Stage 2 fold-local imputation, scaling, and one-hot pipeline fit only on the sampled model-fit subset
resampling: Uniform random undersampling to 1:1 within each outer fold model-fit subset; seed=42+fold

platt_calibration.source: stratified 20% calibration subset of each outer training fold, kept at natural prevalence
platt_calibration.fitting_sequence: fit base model on disjoint undersampled model-fit subset; score calibration subset; fit Platt on those scores and natural labels; score outer validation once

correction.beta: odds(natural training-fold prevalence) / odds(1:1 sampled training prevalence)
correction.prevalence_source: training fold only; validation labels are not used in correction

cv.calibration_split: StratifiedShuffleSplit, 20% of outer training rows, seed=42+fold
